verdict.rationale: Synctera's docs list an API that handles remote deposit capture (RDC) transactions, which covers the check-deposit-with-image-capture half of the story, though only as a one-line mention with no detail on image submission or the deposit workflow. There is no evidence of programmatic check issuance (outbound paper checks). missing for 10: programmatic check issuance/mailing, documented RDC image-capture flow and status handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
